stem.en: ABC Bakery bakes 100 cream buns one morning. Each costs ₹30 to make and sells for ₹60. It rains all day, only 40 buns are sold, and the other 60 spoil and are thrown away. What is the result for the day?

text.en: A profit of ₹1,200, from the 40 buns that were sold.
No profit and no loss, as the sales cover the costs.
A loss of ₹600, as ₹2,400 came in and ₹3,000 went out.
A loss of ₹3,000, as the spoiled buns cancel every sale.

explanation.en: The bakery spent 100 × ₹30 = ₹3,000 in the morning. It collected 40 × ₹60 = ₹2,400. So it made a loss of ₹600, because of the spoiled buns.

hints.en: First find what all 100 buns cost to make, then what the 40 sold buns brought in.
